item.tib: ma mo gsang ba'i thugs sgrub sgrub gzhung phrin las rim pa
item.coloph: ces kyi srid rgyal dre'u nag sgrub pa 'di ni zhu g.yung 'brang phyug mo'i gnas nas gter drangs shing / phyis su rigs ldan gyi mkha' 'gro dbang gi sgron ma dang*/ mchog sprul g.yung drung nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ g.yung drung bstan 'dzin/ dbon po lhun grub sogs dang / khyad par 'dra rtogs ldan g.yung drung dbang rgyal gyis bri gzhi lha reg bcas dang g.yung drung rgyal mtshan/ g.yung drung dpal ldan/ bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal sogs mang pos bskul ngor dbal gter gsang sngags gling pas shog ser mkha'i brda ris la dag par phab cing / yi ge pa ni g.yung drung dpal bzang pos bgyis pas g.yung drung bon bstan rin po che phyogs brgyar rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
